title: Notifications
subtitle: What happened with your debts and your friends.

empty.pendingMessage: When a friend settles a debt or invites you to a group, it will wait here until you see it.
empty.viewedTitle: You have not seen any notification yet
empty.viewedMessage: Notifications you open or dismiss, such as group invitations, will be kept in this section.

markAllRead.label: Mark all as read
markAllRead.accessibilityLabel: Mark every pending notification as read
markAllRead.hint: Marks each pending notification as read and moves it to Seen.

banner.openHint: Opens the related detail and marks the notification as read.

row.openHint: Opens the related detail and marks the notification as read.
row.settlementWalletHint: Opens the settlement to choose your income wallet.

settlement-updated.full: {{name}} updated the settlement of {{amount}}; the debt is settled.

settlement-deleted.full: {{name}} deleted the settlement of {{amount}}; the debt returns to its previous state.

types.group-join-request: Someone wants to join the group “{{group}}”.
types.group-join-accepted: Your request to join the group “{{group}}” was accepted.
types.group-join-rejected: Your request to join the group “{{group}}” was rejected.

errors.NOT_OWNER: This notification does not belong to you.
errors.LOAD_FAILED: Could not load the notifications. Try again.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: Could not update the notification. Try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: The server rejected this operation for permission reasons. Check that you are still signed in with the correct account and try again.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Check your network and try again.
